[[Scelus Prosum]] is an [[Elementalist]] [[Titan]] [[boss]] in [[Hell's Precipice]].

== Items dropped ==
* [[Titan Armor]]

== Notes ==
* Despite being an Elementalist, he runs up to opponents to use melee attacks and [[Inferno]].
* Shares his spawn point with [[Tortitudo Probo]], [[Valetudo Rubor]], [[Maligo Libens]], and [[Moles Quibus]].
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown.  The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses.  The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* In Latin, "scelus" means "crime, calamity, wickedness, sin, evil deed".  "Prosum" means "I am useful for, profitable for, advantageous for, of benefit to".  The full phrase "scelus prosum" therefore seems to mean "I am useful for wickedness", although correct Latin would require the noun to be in the dative case.
